```{r Projection Calculation, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Sets up table inputs
additional_flow <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Additional Inflow to Lake Powell (MAF)", "Length of Addtional Inflow Period (months)"),
  stage_1 = c(0, 0), 
  stage_2 = c(0, 0),
  stage_3 = c(0, 0),
  check.names = FALSE
)

release <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Release Flow from Lake Powell (MAF/yr)", "Length of Release Stage (months)"),
  stage_1 = c(0,0),
  stage_2 = c(0,0),
  stage_3 = c(0,0),
  check.names = FALSE
)


output$additional_flow <- renderRHandsontable({
    rhandsontable(additional_flow)%>%
    hot_col("Parameter", readOnly = TRUE)
  })

output$release <- renderRHandsontable({
    rhandsontable(release)%>%
    hot_col("Parameter", readOnly = TRUE)
})


input_flow <- reactive({
  req(input$additional_flow)
  hot_to_r(input$additional_flow)
})

input_release <- reactive({
  req(input$release)
  hot_to_r(input$release)
})


# Passes inputs through projection function 
projection <- reactive({
  # Insures that there are proper inputs
  tbl <- rbind(input_flow(), input_release())

  add_release <-as.numeric(tbl[1,-1])#[row 1, every column but 1]
  add_time <- as.numeric(tbl[2,-1])
  release <- as.numeric(tbl[3,-1])
  release_time <- as.numeric(tbl[4, -1])
  
  req(length(add_release) > 0, !all(is.na(add_release)))
  req(length(add_time) > 0, !all(is.na(add_time)))
  req(length(release) > 0, !all(is.na(release)))
  req(length(release_time) > 0, !all(is.na(release_time)))
  
  ProjectPowell(
    Inflow = "CRMMS",
    Release = release,
    Release_Time = release_time,
    Add_Release = add_release, 
    Add_Time = add_time,
    Duration = 36,
    Storage_Data = hydrodata
  )
})

# plots projection
output$projectionplot <- renderPlot({
  fplotprojection(projection())
})
```
